headline: Strong launch pipeline augurs well for achieving FY27 guidance

highlights: For FY27, PEPL remains confident of achieving 15–20% sales bookings growth on the back of INR 465bn of new launches in H2FY27.

With an INR 465bn in GDV across the several launches planned for the rest of FY27 – across Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Mumbai and Chennai, PEPL is targeting 15–20% YoY growth in sales bookings and collections.

However, with the company continuing to incur annual land/stake buyout spend of INR 40–50bn and annual annuity capex of INR 40– 50bn, its ability to keep debt levels in check while chasing growth would be crucial.
